programs.title: Chirag
programs.desc: Asha is unable to conceive after marrying Ajay and loses her eyesight, post a traumatic incident. Her mother-in-law drives her out of the house and arranges for Ajay to remarry, an act that will change the lives of everyone in the house.

programs.desc: When Vijay Singh Rajput is unceremoniously stripped of his duties as a bank manager, he decides to seek revenge by robbing the bank. To make the robbery untraceable, he trains three blind men to do the job for him.
